pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pAutomatically constructed starter greenhouse with eight growing cells around central water.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Load logs, stairs, glass and planks into its first four inputs, then press Build.$p2. Prepare dirt/grass beneath the growing area and supply compatible seeds.$p3. Use a Gas Lantern for carbon and an outside chest for permitted seed/produce automation.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pIts roof is wider than the crop area. Wrong construction-slot order, missing energy, denied targets or higher-tier seeds can stall it.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/basic_greenhouse)Construction plans and layers$()
